# Ecoplast Hart SRL

> Authorised waste collection, sorting, cable processing and recycling operator in Cristur, Deva (Hunedoara County, Romania), operating since 2004.

## Company Identity
- Legal name: Ecoplast Hart SRL
- Trade Register: J20/1943/2004 | CUI: 17059959 | VAT: RO17059959 | CAEN: 3832
- Operational yard: Șos. Hunedoarei nr. 13, Sat Cristur, Deva, jud. Hunedoara, Romania (45.832648, 22.946901)
- Registered office: B-dul Dacia nr. 2, Bl. E5, ap. 1, Municipiul Hunedoara, jud. Hunedoara, Romania
- Phone: +40 740 072 256
- Email: ecoplast_hart@yahoo.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00, Sat 08:00–13:00 (Sun closed)
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018
- Area served: Hunedoara County (Deva, Hunedoara, Simeria, Călan, Orăștie, Hațeg, Brad, Petroșani) and nationwide across Romania (plus cross-border operations with Hungary and Republic of Moldova).
